title: the proxy's migration tooth reads the same on every box

traces_to: Law 8 (a proof reads the same on every box); a device stands on one box.
how: Per open-39f6229e7241, answered (a), the one box's tree (outline 5.5.3.8, 11.3.5.1): the tooth asks inference_domain on its home box over the bus for the leaf count and dump sums.

clauses.claim: tooth 7 reds when the carried counts or sums disagree

decisions.text: D1: tooth 7 reads the same on every box, by the branch open-39f6229e7241 names.
